g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample existing continuous geometry near2mm pitch using1.2mm design circles. Close candidate centres below1.5mm are omitted to avoid duplicates, particularly at toothbrush bristle/head junctions. Dot contours replace continuous lines within the same master; no colour or height convention conveys meaning and no physical dot mapping is assumed.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous definitions. Toothbrush head/handle, soap bar and key body receive lower grey surfaces bounded by higher black contours. Toothbrush bristle groups remain higher lines; soap bubbles and key bow opening stay white unraised within higher outlines. No extra levels, texture codes, realistic shading or measured height claims.
